mapper.sql: t.id, t.club_id, t.school_year, t.star_level, t.business_unit, t.basis_note, t.publicity_id, t.register_user_id, t.register_time, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted, c.club_name AS club_name
FROM club_rating t LEFT JOIN club c ON c.id = t.club_id AND c.deleted = 0

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_member cm JOIN student_profile csp ON csp.user_id = cm.user_id AND csp.deleted = 0 WHERE cm.club_id = t.club_id AND cm.deleted = 0 AND cm.quit_date IS NULL AND csp.counselor_id = #{scopeCounselorId})
AND (c.club_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.business_unit LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.basis_note LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO club_rating (club_id, school_year, star_level, business_unit, basis_note, publicity_id, register_user_id, register_time, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{clubId}, #{schoolYear}, #{starLevel}, #{businessUnit}, #{basisNote}, #{publicityId}, #{registerUserId}, #{registerTime}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE t.club_id = #{clubId} AND t.school_year = #{schoolYear} AND t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update:
UPDATE club_rating
school_year = #{r.schoolYear}, star_level = #{r.starLevel}, business_unit = #{r.businessUnit}, basis_note = #{r.basisNote}, publicity_id = #{r.publicityId}, register_user_id = #{r.registerUserId}, register_time = #{r.registerTime}, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = #{r.id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE club_rating SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club_rating t WHERE t.club_id = #{clubId} AND t.school_year = #{schoolYear} AND t.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club_rating t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.star_level = #{starLevel}
SELECT t.star_level AS star_level, COUNT(*) AS total FROM club_rating t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.school_year = #{schoolYear} GROUP BY t.star_level ORDER BY t.star_level
